snippet.title: Stick Out! - Trailer Game Dev Planet
snippet.description:
Try out our latest Demo!
https://parallaxfox.itch.io/stick-out

So... Everything went wrong! We have been having some problems with the publishing of Stick Out! and looking forward to finally throwing it out in the world, we will be releasing on Steam! 

The Steam page will be available next week and will be publishing snapshots and gameplay videos on Instagram so make sure you are following us there:

Our Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/parallaxfoxgames/
